payload.description:
Expose the scanner so a Python Score can obtain findings for a materialized repo/commit without a maze of CLI subprocesses. Observable behavior is the Yes/No stories under this epic.

Plexus Score subclass and registry live on plx-41fcbe / plx-3f0d47. This task is the DataParade callable surface those classes will use.
payload.title: Expose scanner for a Python detector Score
